source.note: 合併契約は終了しています。

relations.text: MaxLinearの年次報告によると、Silicon Motionは2023年8月16日に合併契約の解除を通知し、損害賠償を求める仲裁を始めるとした
relations.text_en: According to MaxLinear's annual report, Silicon Motion gave notice on August 16, 2023 that it was terminating the merger agreement and would start arbitration to seek damages

source.label: MaxLinear 10-K
source.quote: On August 16, 2023, Silicon Motion delivered to us a notice, which Silicon Motion publicly disclosed, that it was purporting to terminate the Merger Agreement and that Silicon Motion would be commencing an arbitration before the Singapore International Arbitration Centre to seek damages from us arising from our alleged breaches of the Merger Agreement.
